note: Which data sheet rows (packs/base-reference) each kernel ground material reads in True, fresh and fully weathered: a measured reflectance spectrum (optical.reflectance), or a refractive index n + ik drawn as a thick layer of grains (Hapke). A drawing choice, not physics: it moves into packs/base-surface (each material naming its rows) in the golden lane; fudge register 'True ground rows named in the renderer'. A material with no row keeps the palette. 'sediment' reads the same soil as 'regolith' (impact-gardened fines on an airless world; on a world with air its stains colour it).
